stem.text: The presence of a halogen in an organic compound may be detected by warming the organic compound with aqueous silver nitrate.
Which compound would be the quickest to produce a precipitate?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched compound with three Cl atoms at terminal positions

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched compound with one Cl atom and two F atoms at terminal positions

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched compound with two F atoms and one I atom at terminal positions

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched compound with one Br atom, one Cl atom and one F atom at terminal positions
